shortDescription: Investors are piling into an arbitrage trade in euro money markets as Europe’s financial conditions tighten, according to Bloomberg.The move reflects shrinking bank liquidity in the region and has helped fuel hedge fund bets on rates.

title: Europe’s Tighter Bank Liquidity Draws Hedge Fund Rates Trades
